lines.en: The captain's whistle sounds, and I walk.
The deck is slick; I move along the rope.
Seawater fills both of my boots.

lines.zh: 三个影子跟着船长，我是第三个。
lines.en: Three shadows follow the captain; I'm the third.

lines.zh: 我踩着前面那人的脚印走。
lines.en: I step in the footprints of the one ahead.
Wet clothes cling to me, heavy.

lines.zh: 我走路的节奏，跟他一样。
lines.en: I walk to the same beat as he does.

lines.zh: 沙子在脚底响，像在数数。
lines.en: Sand rasps underfoot, like counting.
Step around the anchor chain; don't trip.
No wind on deck, and still I sway.
I stay within ten paces of the captain.
A gull lands on the mast and watches me.

lines.zh: 我的脚在甲板上留下水印。
lines.en: My feet leave wet prints on the planks.

lines.zh: 走完这一圈，时间就到了。
lines.en: One more lap and my time is up.
I walk in the captain's shadow.
A gap in the deck catches my foot.
I stand still and count the seconds left.
The captain says nothing; neither do I.

lines.zh: 盐在我脸上结了一层白。
lines.en: Salt has crusted white across my face.

lines.zh: 我摸了摸脖子，绳子勒过。
lines.en: I touch my neck; a rope once bit there.

lines.zh: 浪打在船舷上，一下一下。
lines.en: Waves slap the hull, one after another.

lines.zh: 我记得的只有上船那一刻。
lines.en: All I remember is the moment I came aboard.

lines.zh: 我的手指已经开始透了。
lines.en: My fingers are already turning see-through.

lines.zh: 船舱里有老鼠，我不去管。
lines.en: There are rats below, and I leave them be.
I lean on the mast and rest a moment.
There's a trace of gunpowder in the wind.
My shadow thins out like a water stain.

lines.zh: 我在等一个命令，任何命令。
lines.en: I wait for an order, any order.
Holding this rusty blade turns my palm green.
A few seconds left; I've lost count.
You don't belong to this ship.
Your boots are suspiciously clean.
The captain watches you; so do I.
Set down that rope in your hands.

lines.zh: 你身上没有船长的海水味。
lines.en: You don't smell of the captain's seawater.

lines.zh: 你是被雇来的，还是偷偷上船的？
lines.en: Were you hired, or did you sneak aboard?
Don't stand behind the captain.

lines.zh: 我记得你的脸，刚才见过。
lines.en: I know your face; I saw it a moment ago.

lines.zh: 你在找东西？这里什么都没有。
lines.en: Looking for something? There's nothing here.
Step back; the path I walk is narrow.
Cut me if you like; I'm coming apart anyway.

lines.zh: 这一刀让我少了两根手指。
lines.en: That cut cost me two fingers.
Water runs out of my wound.

lines.zh: 刀口在渗海水，我照样握紧。
lines.en: Seawater seeps from the cut, yet my grip stays tight.
My shoulder's out; I still swing.
A moment of pain beats vanishing.
I fall back to the rail and steady myself.
That blow is nothing at all.
The captain isn't watching; I must hold.
The wound is fading; I'm nearly gone.
That bottle of rum, give me one swallow.
The coins in your pocket are ringing.
Set the food down and I won't chase.

lines.zh: 船长说不能拿，可我想拿。
lines.en: The captain said no, but I want it.
I've stared at that salted meat a long while.
One copper coin would do.
Don't jangle that pouch at me.

lines.zh: 我三十秒里只想要这个。
lines.en: In my thirty seconds, this is all I want.
The smell of drink drifts up from the hold.
I'm reaching for it; don't blame me.

lines.zh: 撞我干嘛，我本来就站不稳。
lines.en: Why shove me? I barely stand as it is.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀撞得我绳子都松了。
lines.en: You knocked the rope loose from my shoulder.
The deck is this wide; make room.

lines.zh: 我撞上你，像撞上一堵墙。
lines.en: I hit you like hitting a wall.

lines.zh: 别踩我的脚，那是我仅剩的。
lines.en: Don't step on my foot; it's all I have left.

lines.zh: 我们俩都在晃，撞得更狠。
lines.en: We're both swaying, so we hit harder.
One step back and I can pass.
Bump me and run? Stand still.
My ribs are dry as bamboo strips.

lines.zh: 水从我袖子里挤出来了。
lines.en: Water squeezes out of my sleeve.

lines.zh: 船上的兄弟，才算自己人。
lines.en: Only the crew counts as my own.

lines.zh: 我这种人，活不过半分钟。
lines.en: My kind doesn't live past half a minute.
Would you stand beside me?
The captain assigns; I never choose.
Two lackeys still make a pair.
When I go, don't be sad.
Aboard ship, closeness is the only warmth.

lines.zh: 我们一起数船长的脚步。
lines.en: Let's count the captain's steps together.
Even my name was given by him.

lines.zh: 你要是留下，我替你挡一刀。
lines.en: Stay, and I'll take a blade for you.
A copper coin on the deck, and I take it.
This rope's still good; I'll keep it.
I pick up the badge the captain dropped.
I gather splinters for kindling.
Whose scabbard is this? Mine now.

lines.zh: 我把湿透的火药捧起来。
lines.en: I scoop up the soaked gunpowder.

lines.zh: 贝壳在甲板上，我捡了一枚。
lines.en: A shell on the planks; I pocket one.

lines.zh: 我捡起自己的手指，收好。
lines.en: I pick up my own finger and keep it.
Half an apple, still edible.
Grab things fast; there's little time.
Someone is climbing over the rail.
Someone is shouting over by the harbor.
I heard the gangplank creak once.
The captain's hand points that way.
A shape moves behind the crates.

lines.zh: 他踩碎了甲板上的一盏灯。
lines.en: He smashed a lantern on the deck.
The target is running for the hatch.
A stranger has drawn a blade.

lines.zh: 那群人开始搬我们的货。
lines.en: Those men are moving our cargo.

lines.zh: 船长吹哨了，我找到他了。
lines.en: The captain whistled; I've found him.
I stand between him and the gangplank.
He goes left, and so do I.
Keep the blade low; show no opening.
I block the hatch first.
He backs to the rail; no way out.
I watch his wrist, not his blade.
A rope lies at my feet; I can use it.

lines.zh: 他还有三步就到我面前。
lines.en: Three steps and he's in front of me.

lines.zh: 船长在我后面，我不能退。
lines.en: The captain's behind me; I can't retreat.
He's panting hard; soon now.
My rusty blade opens his forearm.

lines.zh: 我一刀砍在缆绳上，断了。
lines.en: My cut severs the mooring rope.
He blocks me; I ram his chest.
The blade chips, and I keep swinging.

lines.zh: 这一下带着海水的重量。
lines.en: This swing carries the weight of seawater.
I bite down on his sleeve and hold.

lines.zh: 他退到桅杆边，我压上去。
lines.en: He falls back to the mast; I press in.
My blade is half a beat faster.

lines.zh: 砍中了，木头一样的声音。
lines.en: It lands with a sound like chopping wood.
One more and he goes down.

lines.zh: 船长一迈步，我就出现了。
lines.en: The captain takes a step, and I appear.

lines.zh: 我从他的影子里走出来。
lines.en: I step out of his shadow.

lines.zh: 哨声还没停，我已经站好。
lines.en: The whistle hasn't stopped; I'm already in place.

lines.zh: 我脚下的甲板还是湿的。
lines.en: The deck under my feet is still wet.
I wasn't born; I was called.
The seawater came first, then me.

lines.zh: 我睁眼就看见船长的背。
lines.en: I open my eyes onto the captain's back.

lines.zh: 三十秒，从这一刻开始算。
lines.en: Thirty seconds, counted from right now.
I was dragged out of the surf onto the deck.
Called out to work again.

lines.zh: 火把烧着我的袖子，真烫。
lines.en: The torch burns my sleeve, and it's hot.

lines.zh: 从桅杆上摔下来，散了几块。
lines.en: I fell from the mast and lost a few pieces.

lines.zh: 我沉下去，连气泡都没有。
lines.en: I sink without even a bubble.

lines.zh: 炮弹落在甲板上，我飞了。
lines.en: A cannonball hits the deck and I fly.
An arrow sticks in my chest and wobbles.

lines.zh: 咒语把我从甲板上抹掉一角。
lines.en: A spell wipes a corner off my body.
I stopped getting hungry long ago.
Lightning hits the mast, and I light up.

lines.zh: 掉出船外，底下全是黑的。
lines.en: Over the side, and everything below is black.
